crossRefs.note: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be above all the earth!
Yahweh, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth! You have set your glory above the heavens!
Yahweh, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth!
They sang the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, “Great and marvelous are your works…
Who wouldn’t fear you, Lord, and glorify your name? For you only are holy. For all the nations will come and worship…

translations.web: Be exalted, God, above the heavens. Let your glory be over all the earth.
translations.bsb: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; may Your glory cover all the earth.
translations.kjv: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: let thy glory be above all the earth.
translations.asv: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; Let thy glory be above all the earth. Psalm 58 For the Chief Musician; set to Al-tashheth. A Psalm of David Michtam.
